==Instructions==
This template is to be used for citing individual pages on ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration]] [https://www.starwarscelebration.com official website].

Please note that the website is remade for each Celebration, so you need to identify which one is concerned with {{para|celebration}}.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use. 

<code><nowiki>{{Celebration|url=|text=|celebration=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

====Required parameters====
*{{para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.disneyplus.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{para|text}} Name of the page being cited.
*{{para|celebration}} Name of the event, can be wikilinked.
*'''backup link''', using one of the available methods:
**{{para|archiveurl}} For linking full addresses of alternative archival sites, such as archive.today.
**{{para|archivedate}} The Internet Archive's timestamp of the page.
**{{para|nobackup}} If a permanent archival link for the URL is not available, input <code>1</code> here (for example, <code>nobackup=1</code>) 

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Celebration|url=en-us/panels.html|text=Panels|celebration=[[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]]|archivedate=20220512195429}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Celebration|url=en-us/panels.html|text=Panels|celebration=[[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]]|archivedate=20220512195429}}
